Global context.OpenForm

Global context

OpenForm

Available since version 8.2.

Syntax variant: By name

Syntax:

OpenForm(<FormName>, <Parameters>, <Owner>, <Unique>, <Window>, <NavigationLink>, <NotifyOnCloseDescription>, <WindowOpeningMode>, <WindowRepresentationMode>)

Parameters:

<FormName> (required)

Type: String.
Form name.

<Parameters> (optional)

Type: Structure.
The parameters of the form.

<Unique> (optional)

Type: Arbitrary.
This parameter can be used to set a uniqueness key.

<WindowRepresentationMode> (optional)

Type: FormWindowViewMode.
Sets the display mode of the window where the form will be placed.

Description of method variant:

Opens a form by name.

Syntax variant: By form

Syntax:

OpenForm(<Form>, <Window>)

Parameters:

<Form> (required)

Type: Form, ClientApplicationForm.
A form or a client application form.

Returned value:

Type: Form, ClientApplicationForm.

Description:

Opens and returns a form or a managed form.

Availability:

Thin client, web-client, mobile client, thick client, mobile application (client). Calling the method executes a server call.

See also:

GetForm

Available since:

Available since version 8.2.
